modules.name: 规划者
modules.responsibility: 任何能运行 shell 与 Node.js 的 agent 都可以当规划者（装 skill 用脚本），能加载 MCP 的也可以用 relay_* 工具：Claude Code（插件）、Codex、DeepSeek Harness、Antigravity。规划者自身的模型由宿主决定。

en.name: Planners
en.responsibility: Any agent that can run a shell and Node.js can plan (install the skill and use its script), and MCP clients can use the relay_* tools: Claude Code (as a plugin), Codex, DeepSeek Harness or Antigravity. The planner's own model is the host's to set.
openQuestions: Only a generic MCP client and the CLI were exercised in tests; real Codex, DeepSeek Harness and Antigravity sessions were not run here.

roleAssessment.note: 外部 agent 宿主，不属于前端、后端、缓存、数据库、队列或安全职责。

en.note: External agent hosts; none of the frontend, backend, cache, database, queue or security roles fit.

modules.responsibility: Claude Code 规划者专用 mod：按主循环请求计时，有任务运行且空闲满 55 分钟、缓存仍热、未超上限时用 $.model.fork 保活，冷读即暂停；被盯过的任务结束时唤醒一次；/relay 命令与状态行；执行者角色下不启用。

en.name: Claude planner mod
en.responsibility: The Claude Code planner mod: times main-loop requests and, while jobs run and the session has idled 55 minutes with the cache presumed warm and under the ceiling, refreshes it with $.model.fork, pausing after a cold read; wakes the session once when a watched job ends; /relay and a status line; inactive in the executor role.

modules.responsibility: 配置与派发规则：用户级与项目级配置分层；按规划者身份选 profile（plannerProfiles）；档位到执行者、模型与推理强度的映射；单个任务的模型取值与不支持时失败关闭；config set 的可写键与写前校验；路径规则、light 档护栏、写任务范围冲突、预留执行者失败关闭、执行者角色禁止再派发。

en.name: Dispatch policy
en.responsibility: Configuration and dispatch rules: user and project config layers; profile selection by planner identity (plannerProfiles); tier routes to executor, model and effort; a job's model and effort, failing closed where unsupported; the keys config set may write, validated before writing; path rules, the light-tier guard, write-scope conflicts, fail-closed reserved executors and no dispatch from the executor role.

modules.name: 任务存储与状态机

en.name: Job store
en.responsibility: Job records and their state machine: folders under .agenthub/jobs, atomic writes, O_EXCL locks, legal transitions, the event log and heartbeat liveness; variable names only.

modules.name: 后台 worker
modules.responsibility: 分离的 worker 进程：运行执行者与检查并在超时或取消时结束整棵进程树（POSIX 用进程组先 SIGTERM 再 SIGKILL，Windows 用 taskkill /T /F），每秒读取消标记，心跳，检查经平台 shell 运行并按 Birdview 语义记录，越界审计，终态判定，passEnv 值脱敏；平台差异集中在 src/platform.mjs（命令解析、.cmd 外壳、进程树、带重试的 rename）。

evidence.note: 一个任务从 queued 到终态。

en.note: One job from queued to its final status.

en.note: Ends a process tree: the process group or taskkill.

en.note: Launcher shims that set variables (such as DSH Desktop's dsh.cmd).

en.name: Background worker
en.responsibility: The detached worker: runs executors and checks and ends their whole process tree on timeout or cancel (the process group with SIGTERM then SIGKILL on POSIX, taskkill /T /F on Windows), reads the cancel flag every second, heartbeats, runs checks in the platform shell and records them with Birdview semantics, audits scope, decides the final status and redacts passEnv values; platform differences live in src/platform.mjs (command resolution, .cmd shims, process trees, retried renames).

en.name: Adapters
en.responsibility: Command lines, the executor prompt and output parsing for the three executors; model and effort through the modelArgs/effortArgs templates; claude gets only flags every release knows (acceptEdits for write tiers, no permission mode for reviews); commands resolve through platform.mjs to the program that runs and the variables a shim sets; the environment allow-list (with the system and profile variables Windows needs) and pass-by-name; agy and ACP fail closed.
